detail: D-38 lets memory reads widen by a pin's space once the enforcing guard stops a session from starting a harness outside its tree. SP-041 refuses such a launch only when the command names another job's folder (cd, paths, git -C); a launch in a folder of no space, or hidden in an opaque command (bash -c "$X") under block-other-jobs (opaque_unverified), still runs, as do double forks and launchctl/open/osascript. SP-025 should not assume more, or should require strict mode or other evidence (D-39).
